grammar.title: Comparatives and Superlatives
grammar.explanation:
We use a **comparative** to compare two things. *My bicycle is **faster than** your bicycle.*

We use a **superlative** to say one thing is more than all the others in a group. *Sara had **the best** beach holiday of her life.*

Short adjectives add **-er** and **-est**. *Cheap → **cheaper** → **the cheapest**. A room can be **cheaper than** another room.*

Long adjectives use **more** and **the most**. *A beach holiday is **more expensive than** a day at home. It is **the most relaxing** holiday.*

Some words are irregular. *Good → **better** → **the best**. Bad → **worse** → **the worst**. The bend in the road was **worse than** we thought!*

We use **than** after a comparative. *A train is **faster than** a bicycle.* We use **the** before a superlative. *It is **the longest** road in the town.*

**As ... as** means the same. *My bag is **as heavy as** yours.* **Not as ... as** means less. *The bus is **not as fast as** the train.*

Use **much** to make a comparative stronger. *This room is **much bigger than** my old room.* Do not use *very* with a comparative.
examples: *This is **the most beautiful** beach I've ever seen.* (long adjective — use **the most**)
*The bus is **cheaper than** the train, but it's **less comfortable**.* (**less** is the opposite of more)
*My new flat is **bigger than** my old one.* (big → bigger: double the g)
*That was **the worst** meal of my life.* (bad → the worst)

practice.q: Rewrite with a comparative: A train is fast. A bicycle is slow.
practice.a: A train is faster than a bicycle.

practice.q: Rewrite with a superlative: This beach is beautiful. It is the best beach on the island.
practice.a: This is the most beautiful beach on the island.

practice.q: Rewrite with 'the best': Sara had a good beach holiday. It was the best holiday of her life.
practice.a: It was the best beach holiday of her life.

practice.q: Rewrite with 'not as ... as': The bend is dangerous. The straight road is safe.
practice.a: The straight road is not as dangerous as the bend.
